title: Chapter 136 Your Master Is Still Alive
content:
Chapter 136 Your Master Is Still Alive

How long has I been in the position of sect leader? I actually encountered this kind of thing.

He remembered the horror of the Crazy Emperor back then clearly.

Fight with the nine Immortal Emperor realms without losing the upper hand, and become famous in one battle.

Even now, when you hear the name of the Crazy Emperor again, you will still feel the fear deep in your heart.

If the Crazy Emperor really breaks through the seal and comes to fight here, what should he do?

Thinking of this, the leader of the Xuanzong kept paced anxiously.

And the old man's expression was not much better.

He was one of the nine immortal emperors who participated in the seal of the Mad Emperor.

After so many years, time has long washed away his aura. Facing the Crazy Emperor who broke the seal, even he felt a trace of fear, and he no longer had the unscrupulousness that he was back then.

"From now on, Xuanzong prohibits any entry and exit, and I will go into seclusion."

Leaving this sentence, Emperor Xuan turned around and entered the stone chamber.

The leader of the Xuanzong Sect stood there, his face confused.

Let's just ignore this?

Walking outside and looking at the place where the Crazy Emperor sealed him, the Master of Xuanzong's body could not stop trembling.

And at this time, a surge of breath surged from that direction.

Even if the terrifying aura is thousands of miles apart, you can still feel the suffocation.

Seeing this scene, the leader of the Xuanzong Sect no longer hesitated and directly announced that the Xuanzong would be disbanded!

Let's fly away when the disaster is coming.

Stay with green mountains, and don’t be afraid of burning firewood.

Any reputation and status are all false, and only living is the most important thing.

He could see this very thoroughly.

However, he saw it very thoroughly, while the other strong people in the sect were a little confused.

"Sect Master, I don't agree, even if,"

An elder who had a great status in Xuanzong immediately stepped forward and said dissatisfied.

However, before he finished speaking, he had already seen the leader of the Xuanzong sect carry his bag.

"You are wrong. I am not asking you, but informing you, you can do whatever you want."

Immediately, he left Xuanzong without looking back.

The senior leaders of Xuanzong who had not yet reacted were left behind.

They said they had never seen their sect leader's eyes so firmly.

"this,,"

"Great Elder, are we really going to disband?"

Everyone looked at the Great Elder of Xuanzong. When the sect leader was not present, the Great Elder became the backbone of the sect.

Looking at everyone's hopeful gaze, the Great Elder suddenly felt a sense of superiority that he had never felt before.

With a light cough, the Great Elder said slowly: "Do you think Xuanzong should be disbanded?"

The Great Elder did not answer, but asked them back.

Hearing this, everyone was silent.

At this moment, the third elder suddenly smiled and said, "Great Elder, we listen to you. Next, no matter what decision you make, we will support you."

When the rest of the people heard this, they nodded immediately and expressed their support.

Hearing the satisfactory answer, the Great Elder laughed.

I really didn't expect that my chance to get to power would come so suddenly.

"From now on, everything in the sect will be the same. Since Xuan'an chose to escape because of fear, he will no longer be a member of my Xuanzong. My Xuanzong will not have a coward!"

The Great Elder immediately said passionately.

As soon as these words came out, everyone's blood was boiling.

"The Great Elder said it well!"

"No, I should be called Master Sect Master."

"Yes! Sect Master, I have met Sect Master!"

Everyone cheered.

At this time, everything is moving in a good direction, at least in the eyes of the Great Elder.

The source of all this confidence is because he knows that the ancestor of the sect is still there. Although so long has passed, he believes that the ancestor of the present must have become stronger than before.

It is naturally easy to deal with the Crazy Emperor who has sealed the endless years.

However, he had no idea that the ancestor of Xuanzong had also quietly ran away.

The fatal danger is approaching quietly.

On the other side.

The other forces also changed, but basically no major changes were made.

Obviously, so many years have passed, and although the influence of the Crazy Emperor is still very large, it has become much weaker after all.

Inside the sealed land.

At this moment, the place was already broken, leaving only the messy Anhui wind standing there watching the surroundings.

Who am I, where am I, what happened.

The seal that had been imprisoned for so many years was ruined with one punch?

Looking at Lu Daosheng with a calm expression in front of him, Wan Feng swallowed his saliva and hesitated: "Is my master really your wife?"

Seeing that Wan Feng was still a little suspicious, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"Can you stop asking such a stupid question?"

He was really annoyed.

Lu Daosheng obviously did not have much patience for people other than his relatives.

Neglecting Anfeng, Lu Daosheng took out a stone that exuded an ancient aura.

"This object is called the Forbidden Ancient Stone, which is one of the sources of the Forbidden Power. Carrying it on your body can not only suppress the riots of the Forbidden Power, but also help you control it."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stuffed it directly into Wan Feng's hand.

Looking at the taboo ancient stone in his hand, Wan Feng suddenly felt the almost endless taboo power inside it. For a moment, Wan Feng was in a deep mind.

I suddenly felt very stupid about the question just now.

You can take out this kind of magical object at will.

Is it necessary to deceive yourself in this existence?

At this time, Lu Daosheng had turned around and left. Seeing this, Wan Feng paused and hurriedly stepped forward and chased after him.

"Master! Wait!"

Wanfeng caught up with Lu Daosheng.

"Master, I have many questions to ask you."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Wan Feng's eyes were sincere.

His master has long been dead. Since Lu Daosheng said that his master is his wife, does that mean it?

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng did not hide it.

"Your master, she is still alive."

Hearing this, Wan Feng was stunned and stunned. The next moment, hot tears suddenly burst out from his eyes.

For many years, she has been immersed in pain and regret for so many years.

She hated her, hated that she was incompetent and could not do anything for her master.

From the day she became a disciple, she knew that Yan Lingyun had indescribable internal injuries. Unfortunately, even though she had searched all over the Wood Fairy World, she had not found anything that could heal her master's injuries.

Until later, I watched my master die and die.

Now, when she heard the news that her master was still alive, her mood could no longer be described in words.

In place, looking at the Anhui wind that kept crying and trembling all over, Lu Daosheng felt a little throbbing inside.

My wife's eyes are pretty good.

Waving his hand, a gentle force suddenly brushed across Wan Feng's entire body. In just a moment, a clean and beautiful woman stood in front of Lu Daosheng.

It's completely different from before.

"Your master is very good now. After a while, she will come to the Wood Immortal Realm."

Upon hearing this, Wan Feng's expression was shaking and he nodded repeatedly.

At this moment, she had no longer any doubts about Lu Daosheng's words.

"Master, is there anything I can do for you?"

Lu Daosheng saved her, and she was his master's man, and he no longer knew how to repay her.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, nodded and said, "There is really something."

He intends to create another deserted city in the Wood Fairy Realm, as the reception point for the people of the Lower Realm to ascend to the Wasteland City, just like before.

He originally planned to experience this matter himself, but he looked at the Anhui Feng in front of him.

Isn't this a ready-made candidate?

After all, I am an invincible existence. If I do it myself, I would be a little unqualified.
